findings.issue: כַּאֲשֶׁר (preposition + relative) licenses a factual comparison, «como» / «según» you did. «como que» in current Latin American Spanish means «as if» or «kind of», adding a hypothetical or hedge the token does not license.

notes: The rest matches: Jehová, Moisés, jussive 2ms, both object suffixes, singular hand, perfect 1cs, pueblo, tierra, sequential 2ms, לּוֹ, Sihón, singular gentilic, and the active participle in Jeshbón.
